info.title: TanoImg HTTP API
info.description: Source-controlled API reference. Responses use a success/data envelope or success/message error envelope. Generic schemas on older endpoints describe the envelope; newer upload and transfer endpoints have detailed schemas.

get.description: Application-observed successful image response bytes. Cost uses the configured egress price and is an estimate, not provider billing.

post.description: Disk-backed single-image upload session. Authenticate each request with the same administrator session or API key. Sessions expire 24 hours after their last update; finalize verifies the declared SHA-256 and creates the image.
